result.summary: Adds a new testsubmitpackage RPC that validates a strict parent+child (1p1c) transaction bundle against full package-relay policy, including RBF and sibling-eviction checks, without mutating the mempool. It reuses and extends ProcessNewPackage/AcceptPackage machinery with a new test_package_feerates flag and threads test_accept-only handling through several validation.cpp code paths. A large new functional test file (686 lines) exercises the new RPC.
result.problem: Wallets and higher layers (notably Lightning implementations doing CPFP fee-bumping) currently have no reliable way to test whether a proposed parent+child package would be accepted, including RBF and sibling-eviction outcomes, without actually broadcasting it. This PR is a partial fix for issue #32160.

result.card: This PR adds a new testsubmitpackage RPC that lets callers test-validate a parent+child (1p1c) CPFP package against full package-relay policy, including RBF and sibling-eviction outcomes, without mutating the mempool. It targets a real gap flagged in issue #32160 and echoed by LN-adjacent tooling (LND-style pre-broadcast testflight), but the author himself expressed doubt about how much user demand exists and paused further iteration pending buy-in. Reviewer ismaelsadeeq gave a concept ACK alongside substantial unaddressed code-review requests (deduplicating changeset-copy logic, splitting the test-only dry-run path out of ProcessNewPackage), and dergoegge's month-old request for explicit confirmation of user demand has gone unanswered. The PR is a draft, needs a rebase, and the author has been silent for over 90 days, so it is not currently reviewable. It touches core package-acceptance internals in validation.cpp in a way that a validation reviewer should check for leakage into the real submission path, even though behavior is gated behind test_accept.
